correctness.rationale: Every σ-cycle has either all zero coordinates or a nonzero solution of x=βx^(2^ell); because a final independent coefficient enters β with exponent 1, β is uniform in F_q^*. Hence cycle idempotent factor 1+g_ell with probability 1/g_ell, else 1, independently. Permutation cycle index yields the stated all-moment EGF and mean n+1. For r=2 use divisor-sum gcd identity and product (1-z)^(-4)∏(1-z^ord_d(2))^(-φ(d)/ord_d(2)); z=1 dominates all other roots of unity and gives variance asymptotic. Bounded cycle contributions, negative cross-covariances and periodic g_ell yield L2 exponent κ_q. q=4 odd cycles always have 2 idempotents while even cycles have no-nonzero probability 2/3, giving (1-z²)^(-1/3). Every theorem quantifier fixes q and varies n.
